clue.text: Celestial origins of big bang?

parts.note: the 'big bang' is not the cosmic one but a crash of thunder, which comes from dark masses in the sky

explanation.surface: A question about where the universe began.
explanation.definitionFit: Thunder, a loud bang, rolls out of heavy storm masses overhead in the sky.

clue.text: Bull may suffer during this

parts.note: the bull is not an animal but the bullseye, the centre of a target that gets hit repeatedly in a shooting session

explanation.surface: A bull suffering, as at a bullfight.
explanation.definitionFit: Shooting drills aim at a board whose centre is called the bull, so it takes the punishment.

clue.text: Final warning from Tim, and mutual jostling

indicators.note: jostling pushes things about, so the letters of the two words are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Tim and a friend jostle each other until one issues a final warning.
explanation.definitionFit: A last demand before action is taken, with no further chance offered.

clue.text: No light in deckhouse initially, and boat by headland

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word deckhouse

parts.note: Noah's ark is a boat
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or place names like Sheerness

explanation.surface: A deckhouse with no light, a boat moored by a headland at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Darkness is the absence of illumination.

clue.text: Drops rule, one hears

indicators.note: one hears signals that the word is to be taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a monarch's reign is their rule

explanation.surface: Someone dropping a rule they have heard of.
explanation.definitionFit: Water falling from clouds comes down in drops.

clue.text: Heather having disturbed night, it strikes one

indicators.note: having means holding something within, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: ling is another name for common heather

indicators.note: disturbed means stirred up, so the letters of night are rearranged

explanation.surface: Heather had a disturbed night and something strikes her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name but is the plant, LING. 'disturbed' turns NIGHT into IGHTN, which 'having' puts inside LING.
explanation.definitionFit: A bolt from a storm hits a person or object, sometimes fatally.

clue.text: Part coming up in Verdi, as Nubian? Not mentioned

indicators.note: coming up in a down clue means the letters read from bottom to top, backwards
Part says only a portion of the run of letters across these words is used

explanation.surface: A Nubian character from a Verdi opera, as in Aida, is never mentioned.
explanation.walkthrough: DIASNU, taken from 'Verdi, as Nubian', is reversed by 'coming up', which suits a down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left unspoken has not been said aloud by anyone.

clue.text: Smooth patch

definitions.meaning: glossy or polished, as smooth hair is
a patch of oil on water

explanation.definitionFit: Glossy and polished hair is slick; a film of spilt oil on the sea is a slick.

clue.text: Caption on Durer strangely not included

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of the caption words come out in an odd new order

explanation.surface: A caption on a Durer engraving is strangely left out.
explanation.walkthrough: Durer is Albrecht Durer, the German Renaissance artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not made part of a larger body or company stands outside it.

clue.text: It provides lift each way

indicators.note: each way says the letters read the same forwards as backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A thing giving lift from either direction, like an each-way bet.
explanation.walkthrough: A helicopter's spinning blades give lift; the word reads identically in both directions.
explanation.definitionFit: The rotating blade assembly of a helicopter raises it into the air.

clue.text: Dyspepsia — Di avoided eating

indicators.note: avoided means the named letters are kept out and dropped from the longer word

parts.note: dyspepsia is the medical word for indigestion
taken as written, a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman named Di has stomach trouble and has stopped eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking food into the body by swallowing it.

clue.text: Queen has hole in fur

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
a mine is a hole dug in the ground

explanation.surface: The Queen has a hole in her fur coat.
explanation.definitionFit: The white winter coat of the stoat, used for royal robes.

clue.text: Badly hit, wrench gun around

indicators.note: around says one word goes about the other, enclosing it

parts.note: the Sten is a British submachine gun
to rick is to wrench or sprain a joint

explanation.surface: Someone badly hurt as a gun is wrenched around.
explanation.definitionFit: Struck down or afflicted by something severe, like an illness or grief.

clue.text: Fancy pastries — i.e. here?

indicators.note: Fancy as a verb means imagine, so the letters of pastries are reworked

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that fancy pastries are to be found right here.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a shop selling fancy cakes is where they are found.
explanation.definitionFit: A French cake shop is the place where fine baked sweets are sold.

clue.text: Moves abroad -it's good in Arab states

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: the Emirates are Arab states on the Gulf

explanation.surface: Someone moving abroad finds life good in the Gulf states.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who leaves their home country to settle elsewhere relocates overseas.

clue.text: Three things to put round centre of atrium

indicators.note: put round says one word wraps around the other piece

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letters of the word atrium

explanation.surface: Three objects placed around the middle of an atrium.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of three of anything is a threesome.

clue.text: Selects new cardinals?

parts.note: cardinals are not churchmen but cardinal numbers, so selecting new ones means assigning fresh figures

explanation.surface: The Pope chooses new cardinals.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving fresh figures in sequence, cardinal meaning a counting number.

clue.text: Spat chewed stuff in a hole

indicators.note: in says the chewed stuff goes inside the hole

parts.note: a rent is a tear or hole in fabric
gum is something chewed

explanation.surface: Someone spat chewing gum into a hole.
explanation.definitionFit: A spat is a petty quarrel, a row.

clue.text: Soldiers run into woman

indicators.note: into says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Amy is a woman's name
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Soldiers run into a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A land force made up of troops.

clue.text: Tough cookie: criticises chap returning after a drink

indicators.note: after says what follows comes later than the drink in the answer

parts.note: gin is a drink

indicators.note: returning means the words criticises and chap are read backwards together

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly
Reg is a man's name, any chap

explanation.surface: A tough character criticises a man coming back from a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard ginger biscuit, and biscuits are cookies in America.

clue.text: Period of play for 25 making illegal deliveries, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is to be taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: 25 refers to the answer at 25 across, and one who throws rather than bowls the ball is a chucker

explanation.surface: A spell of play for a bowler sending down illegal balls.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, throwing the ball instead of bowling it is illegal and called chucking. A chukka is one of the timed periods in polo.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the timed periods into which a polo match is divided.

clue.text: Garment supports one, right after hospital

indicators.note: after says one and right come later than hospital in the answer

parts.note: tees support golf balls
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Clothes support a patient once discharged from hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: A short-sleeved casual top is an item of clothing.

clue.text: Girl, in US, taking morning off

indicators.note: off says the named letters are taken away from the word

parts.note: the US is America
AM is morning

explanation.surface: A girl in the States taking the morning off.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is a girl's name.

clue.text: Bird in distant, German city

indicators.note: in says the city goes inside the word for distant

parts.note: far means distant
Ulm is a city in Germany

explanation.surface: A bird in a far-off German city.
explanation.definitionFit: A grey and white seabird of northern oceans, related to petrels.

clue.text: Heck! Road not even, twisted instep

indicators.note: twisted here means turned around so the letters run backwards
not even says the odd-placed letters of each word are kept

explanation.surface: An exclamation at an uneven road that twisted someone's foot.
explanation.walkthrough: HC from 'Heck' and RA from 'Road' make HCRA, which 'twisted' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: The raised curve of the foot's sole between ball and heel.

clue.text: Covers his situation, perhaps

parts.note: covers is not hides but a fielding position in cricket, where such a player might stand

explanation.surface: Someone covering up their situation.
explanation.definitionFit: Cover is a fielding position in cricket, so a fielder may stand there.

clue.text: Happening to be in flat with temperature

parts.note: even means flat or level

explanation.surface: Something happening in a flat with a rising temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: An occurrence is something that takes place.

clue.text: At seaside then slipping, knocked out

indicators.note: slipping suggests sliding out of place, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone slipping at the seaside is knocked out.
explanation.definitionFit: Made unconscious by drugs before surgery, like being rendered senseless.
